## What this PR adds or changes

- [ ] New pattern / 新条目
- [ ] Improves an existing pattern / 改进已有条目
- [ ] Site code / 网站代码

## Checklist
- [ ] One YAML file per pattern in `content/patterns/`, file name = `slug`
- [ ] `title`, `summary`, `symptom`, `why` have both `en` and `zh`
- [ ] Exactly one category: `wrong-feature`, `bug` or `overreach`
- [ ] At least one source link; no invented statistics or quotes
- [ ] Code examples anonymized, no secrets
- [ ] `npm run validate` and `npm run build` pass
